issues.description: The problem statement (German) asks for sums grouped by 'Regierungsbezirk' (task text uses the German term), but the reference solution (aufgabe04.sql) selects the column regierungsbezirk and aliases it as 'District' (English). This changes the displayed identifier for the same conceptual entity across artifacts and may create a small mapping/confusion for students expecting the German column name from the task description and schema.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep the displayed column name consistent with the problem wording and schema. Replace the alias 'AS District' with either no alias or a German alias, e.g. 'AS regierungsbezirk' or remove the alias so the column remains regierungsbezirk.
